name: oneshot-math
description: One-shot RGS math generator: per-mode books, sequential event indexes, lookup tables, RTP, and max-win in a single pass.

scripts.generate: tsx src/cli.ts generate --game games/demo-lines --out out/demo-lines --mode all
scripts.generate:base: tsx src/cli.ts generate --game games/demo-lines --out out/demo-lines --mode base
scripts.generate:bonus: tsx src/cli.ts generate --game games/demo-lines --out out/demo-lines --mode bonus
